privacy_review_reason: Ownership/enrollment records may identify natural persons; NSSRN is respondent-level survey microdata. Review the exact fields and applicable terms before asserting the downloader's no-personal-data contract. This is an acquisition control, not predictor exclusion.
large_file_review_reason: Only a prefix was previously inspected. Establish complete export size and a tested bounded large-file strategy; the existing batch supports at most 512 MiB per file. Never treat a bounded prefix as complete history.

source_actions.history_action: Enumerate dated and annual CMS hospital archives; reconcile nested annual snapshots and changing filenames without stacking duplicate releases. Register new routes before capture. Check each requested table's presence independently, including maternal absence in the oldest inspected release.
source_actions.extraction_action: Use the publisher manifest where present. Older manifest-free archives require a hash-pinned member-to-table map; never assign all CSVs to the requested source. Share dictionary and footnote files by release. Preserve the Measure Dates size-conflict hold.

source_actions.history_action: Reconcile every catalog distribution and date-specific revision against the recorded routes. Preserve source snapshot dates, cost-report periods and calendar years separately. Shared URLs are reuse candidates, not additional datasets.
source_actions.extraction_action: Retain complete CSV bytes and release-matched dictionaries. Keep provider, provider-DRG, ownership, enrollment and event tables separate; no deduplication or joins during capture.

source_actions.history_action: Enumerate proposed, final, correction and supplemental IPPS packages across all available fiscal years. Keep payment FY distinct from source MedPAR FY or occupational survey interval. Preserve the reviewed FY2020 CMI route in FY2022 alternatives packaging.
source_actions.extraction_action: Inventory each ZIP, preserve XLS/XLSX workbooks intact and map each member explicitly. Retain readme/layout sheets for later review; do not unpack Office workbook internals as datasets or substitute proposed statistics for final statistics.

source_actions.history_action: Enumerate version-specific documentation from recorded publisher pages. Preserve date/version applicability; a current manual does not document every historical release.
source_actions.extraction_action: Store documentation under collection references, never as observed hospital measures. HTML landing/index pages require a separately selected document route. Preserve unsuccessful access evidence.

source_actions.history_action: Enumerate CKAN resources from both current and pre-2012 catalogs. Use reviewed full datastore dumps when workbook access fails. Keep financial and utilization populations separate and do not interpret a notes-only export as numeric data.
source_actions.extraction_action: Record resource ID, full export scope and BOM choice. Capture the complete CSV with no row/field filters; retain hospital reporting intervals and separate account/variable dictionaries. Do not reuse expiring signed redirects.

source_actions.history_action: Enumerate publisher file directories for every available release and geography. The inspected ACS table and Alabama SAIPE file are bounded scopes, not national full-feature coverage. Preserve all requested table codes and older sequence-based layouts.
source_actions.extraction_action: Retain fixed-width/delimited bytes, geography files, table shells and release-specific layouts. Map ZIP members before storage and do not infer measurement intervals from retrieval years.

source_actions.history_action: Enumerate every publisher vintage and correction; preserve geography vintage, boundary changes and multi-year input windows. Do not manufacture annual releases from intermittent classifications.
source_actions.extraction_action: Use complete published tables or full CSV exports. Keep geography identifiers as strings, dictionaries by vintage and national/state/county/tract rows distinct during later review.

source_actions.history_action: Enumerate HRSA historical packages where available. Current designation snapshots do not establish historical as-of coverage. Retain unresolved history rather than backfilling current values.
source_actions.extraction_action: Map AHRF main/category members without counting repeated category packaging as independent data; retain user/technical documentation. Keep HPSA and MUA/P components separate with their metadata workbooks.

source_actions.history_action: Recheck permitted bulk-file availability before fallback. Resolve the county-series crosswalk, available start/end years and annual versus monthly scope before building all-county API chunks.
source_actions.extraction_action: If fallback remains necessary, use at most 25 verified county LAUS series and ten years per v1 request. Enforce the existing rolling 25-request budget including retries; retain response warnings and missing periods as holds.

source_actions.history_action: Capture the approved paginated hospital directory for identifier discovery, then review and register each hospital's full CSV export. The two inspected hospitals do not establish statewide acquisition. Keep demo-ID exclusions for analytical eligibility without deleting raw records.
source_actions.extraction_action: Numeric histories remain file-first. The directory fallback is for missing identifiers, not a replacement numeric API. Record every page, expected totals and termination; retain all missing-year/denominator checks.

source_actions.history_action: Record explicit permitted UI selections for available population, geography, year and measure combinations before saving exports. A map/report landing page is not a direct CSV endpoint; enumerate historical report coverage separately.
source_actions.extraction_action: Preserve export selections and exact downloaded bytes. Named-hospital HTML reports need a tested report-table extractor; do not send their pages through the generic numeric-file capture path or evade a denied request.

source_actions.history_action: Enumerate publisher report archives and years while distinguishing named-hospital reports from state, region and participating-cohort summaries. Keep changing report URLs and revisions in provenance.
source_actions.extraction_action: Store PDFs/DOCX reports as untransformed data documents and retain separate methodology files. Numeric extraction with page/table/chart references belongs to later review. XLSX stays intact; definitions-only workbooks are references.

source_actions.history_action: Enumerate NSSRN survey waves and accompanying public-use documentation. Retain survey year, employment reference dates and disclosure restrictions; no hospital-level response panel is implied.
source_actions.extraction_action: Review respondent-level privacy/terms and hash-pin ASCII member layouts before capture. Preserve weights and codebooks; any area aggregation is deferred, not silently performed during acquisition.

source_actions.history_action: Treat the shared hospital-week export as one physical source with two registry scopes. Determine full byte size, complete dates and correction status before execution; no separate API is inferred from the export URL.
source_actions.extraction_action: Develop and test the large-file capture path if the complete export exceeds 512 MiB. Preserve all raw columns and hospital-week records, with one shared dictionary; never upload the existing sample as complete data.

source_actions.history_action: Enumerate all published hospital Promoting Interoperability releases and their documentation, retaining eligible-hospital and reporting-year scope.
source_actions.extraction_action: Keep product rows intact; later hospital aggregation must address multiple products and reporting instances. Obtain release-specific field definitions before schema review.

source_actions.history_action: Keep this source in the full pool while its documented access or licensing hold remains unresolved. Revisit only permitted publisher routes or obtain an explicit lawful access disposition; do not bypass denials, authentication, TLS checks or terms.
source_actions.extraction_action: No numeric capture is executable while the source hold remains. Documentation does not release response data; preserve source-specific blocking evidence and required checks.
